description1-director: I am a doctor, and alongside helping people heal physically, I'm passionate about starting a community project to support the mental well-being of the Vietnamese community.
description2-director: I am a drummer. Leading bands and performing at events brings me joy, and I'm dedicated to bringing the Vietnamese community together through music and creativity.
music-description-introduction: With professional performers, our music lessons and workshops offer participants the opportunity to learn, grow, and connect with the art of music
sport-description-introduction: From exciting competitions to hands-on skill-building sessions, we invite everyone to join in - regardless of age or experience. Have fun, improve your skills, connect with others, and enjoy being part of a welcoming, vibrant, and inclusive community of sports lovers.
title-big-introduction: Connect Community Through Sports, Musics And Arts
title-small-introduction: A non-profit organization dedicated to fostering creativity, innovation, and community engagement in Vancouver
